components.role: Python stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer on port 8088; SQLite persistence; simulation and scheduled jobs

simulation_modules.role: Seeded authoritative simulate(teams, seed, league_rules); actions, events, score, clips over 5400 match seconds

Build frozen league replay and compress it outside the standings transaction
Action-complete highlight selection, exactly 450 presentation seconds per half
Bounded acceleration integration, Hermite player motion frames
Scenario selection metadata attached to preparation/snapshots

database.schema_inspection: Static CREATE TABLE and ALTER TABLE declarations; database not opened

club_states.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS club_states(
                    team_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES league_teams(id), league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, base_ovr REAL NOT NULL, cash INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    debt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fitness REAL NOT NULL, fitness_at REAL NOT NULL,
                    tactics TEXT NOT NULL, lineup TEXT NOT NULL, training TEXT NOT NULL,
                    next_training REAL NOT NULL, pending_training TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL);

club_leagues.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS club_leagues(
                    league_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, season INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);

club_watchlist.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS club_watchlist(
                    team_id TEXT NOT NULL, player_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(team_id,player_id));

club_offers.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS club_offers(
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, league_id TEXT NOT NULL, player_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    buyer TEXT NOT NULL, seller TEXT, buyer_generation TEXT NOT NULL,
                    seller_generation TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, proposer TEXT NOT NULL,
                    price INTEGER NOT NULL, wage INTEGER NOT NULL, seasons INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    reserved INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    created_at REAL NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL, note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

club_fixture_snapshots.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS club_fixture_snapshots(
                    fixture_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, season INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL);

club_matchdays.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS club_matchdays(
                    league_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES leagues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    season INTEGER NOT NULL,matchday INTEGER NOT NULL,kickoff_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    lock_at INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,completed_at REAL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(league_id,season,matchday));

users.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
                    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
                    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    salt TEXT NOT NULL,
                    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    club_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Como 1907 (Original)',
                    club_short_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COMO',
                    coins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    cash_balance_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25000000000,
                    unread_notifications INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    failed_login_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    lockout_until INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    last_login_at INTEGER DEFAULT NULL
                );

otps.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS otps (
                    email TEXT PRIMARY KEY COLLATE NOCASE,
                    code TEXT NOT NULL,
                    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
                );

sessions.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
                    token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    refresh_token TEXT,
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    device_id TEXT DEFAULT 'Android Client',
                    ip_address TEXT DEFAULT '127.0.0.1',
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    refresh_expires_at INTEGER,
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );

leagues.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leagues (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    invite_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
                    creator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    team_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(team_count IN (8, 10, 16, 20)),
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PRE_SEASON' CHECK(status IN ('PRE_SEASON', 'ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED')),
                    preseason_ends_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    current_matchday INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    total_matchdays INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (creator_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );

league_teams.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS league_teams (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    team_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    team_short_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    logo_url TEXT DEFAULT '',
                    rating INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 75,
                    manager_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    manager_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    is_bot INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    played INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    won INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    drawn INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    lost INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    goals_for INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    goals_against INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    goal_diff INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    bot_wins_against_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (league_id) REFERENCES leagues (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (manager_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
                );

career_slots.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_slots (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    slot_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(slot_number BETWEEN 1 AND 6),
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EMPTY' CHECK(status IN ('EMPTY', 'ACTIVE')),
                    league_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    team_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
                    joined_at INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (league_id) REFERENCES leagues (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES league_teams (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
                    UNIQUE(user_id, slot_number)
                );

fixtures.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fixtures (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    matchday INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    home_team_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    away_team_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    home_score INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    away_score INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    is_played INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    played_at INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (league_id) REFERENCES leagues (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (home_team_id) REFERENCES league_teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    FOREIGN KEY (away_team_id) REFERENCES league_teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );

friendly_wallets.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS friendly_wallets (
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL, slot_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    tickets INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
                    next_ticket_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    PRIMARY KEY(user_id,slot_number),
                    FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                );

friendly_matches.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS friendly_matches (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, slot_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    generation TEXT NOT NULL, opponent_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('PREPARING','READY','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED','EXPIRED')),
                    seed TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
                    started_at REAL, ends_at REAL, completed_at REAL, package BLOB,
                    home_score INTEGER, away_score INTEGER, error TEXT,
                    reward_applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rules_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                    UNIQUE(user_id,request_key)
                );

flow: OkHttp requests JSON envelope; code consumes success/data
FriendlyRepository.cacheReplay validates all replay version tags
Atomic local save: filesDir/friendly/{id}.json using temp + rename
Intent starts FriendlyMatchActivity with matchId, offsetSeconds, replay, startPending
Godot loads lawatan.pck; LawatanBridge.getReplay returns cached JSON
replay_timeline.gd maps presentation clock to match time and 0.5x repeat time

android_and_viewer.offline: Supported after replay is cached; ClubRepository uses same viewer for completed league matches without friendly start/settle
android_and_viewer.live_clock: serverNow-startedAt + monotonic SystemClock.elapsedRealtime delta; live Godot clock syncs through bridge
android_and_viewer.playback_clock: Completed replay starts at zero after viewer readiness and advances locally
